name: Cameron Aaron Portfolio

tools.name: get_profile

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: Returns Cameron Aaron's portfolio projects including research, software, and security projects.

featured.description: When true, returns only featured projects.

tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: Returns Cameron Aaron's professional work experience history sorted by recency.

tools.name: get_education
tools.description: Returns Cameron Aaron's academic education, degrees, and current prerequisite coursework.

tools.name: get_certifications

tools.name: get_contact_info
